description: Canine Bat Hybrid default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/canine_bat-character-sheet.png (intake.json swatch chips 37,34,37 / 87,76,84 / 189,169,165 / 137,106,116 / 104,74,89 + direct medians of the drawn surfaces, sample px cited per region). Dark plum-charcoal fur, a pale fluffy neck ruff, lighter grey-mauve lower legs / paws / inner thighs / belly, a mauve-grey snout, mauve ear membranes with a dark rim + faint darker-mauve veins, big dark eyes with a pale rim + highlight, two cream fangs. No glow (brief): every region writes zero Glow.
